title: Umphefumulo ozinikele womlilo ongcwele
intro: Ngaphambi kwakho kulele indaba yesibindi esingavamile, lapho umuntu oyedwa enesibindi sokuphonsela inselelo izinkolelo ezigxilile kakhulu zempucuko yonke. Landela la mazwi amahlebezi avela esikhathini esidlule, futhi uzokwembula impilo ephawulwe ukholo olungapheli, ukusinda okumangalisayo, kanye nokubekwa kwezisekelo ezazizobumba uhambo olungokomoya lwezigidigidi. Landela umkhondo ngamunye ngokucophelela - umlilo ongcwele usakhumbula.
clues: Ngazalelwa emndenini owawuhlonipha izidalwa zasezulwini nezithombe ezibaziweyo, kodwa kukhona okuthile okujulile kimi okwenqaba lokho ababekukhulekela.
Ngimelene nombusi onamandla kunabo bonke ezweni lakithi, ngaphula zona kanye izithombe abantu bami ababezikhothamela, futhi ngamemezela ukuthi uMdali wamazulu kuphela ofanelwe ukuzinikela.
Kwayalwa umlilo ovuthayo egameni lami, kodwa ngamemezela ukuthi Lowo engimkhonza yedwa uzongisindisa — futhi amalangabi ayalwa ukuba aphole futhi aphephe.
Ngashiya konke engikujwayele ngomyalo kaNkulunkulu, ngizulazula ezigodini ezomile nomndeni wami, ngithembele ekudleni engangingakuboni okwamanje.
Simi eceleni kwendodana yami eyizibulo esigodini esingenalutho, sakha ndawonye izisekelo zendlu engcwele, indawo engcwele eyenzelwe bonke abazithobayo.
Ngaziwa ngokuthi uKhalilullah — umngane oseduze woMuntu Onomusa — futhi igama lami lahlala lihlotshaniswa nokholo lokuzinikela nokuzithoba.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
